name: B10-0230/2026 (ECR) – Escalating trafficking and exploitation by criminal groups in Haiti
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on escalating trafficking and exploitation by criminal groups in Haiti
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and calling for action on Haiti. It condemns the exploitation and trafficking of people, especially children and women, by armed criminal groups. It asks Haiti's authorities, with help from the European Union and other partners, to break up trafficking networks and prosecute those responsible. It also asks the international community to support justice, protect vulnerable people, and tackle illegal arms and money flows.

- The Parliament asks for action, not new laws; nothing changes directly.
- It affects Haiti's people, especially children and women, and the authorities there.
- Next, the resolution goes to member states, the Council, the Commission and Haiti's authorities.
